mapper.select: /** [sql-output.xml] OutputMapper.getOutputRequestSel **/ SELECT MF14_COMPANY , MF14_FACTORY , MF14_HNO , MF13_NO , MF13_DAT , MF13_DAT_TIME , MF13_LINE_CODE , MF14_NO , MF14_SEQ , MF14_CODE , CM08_DGBN , CM08_NAME , CM08_GBN , MF14_GBN , MF14_QTY , MF14_UNT FROM TB_MF_14 mf14 LEFT JOIN TB_MF_13 mf13 ON mf14.MF14_COMPANY = mf13.MF13_COMPANY AND mf14.MF14_FACTORY = mf13.MF13_FACTORY AND mf14.MF14_HNO = mf13.MF13_NO LEFT JOIN TB_CM_08 cm08 ON mf14.MF14_COMPANY = cm08.CM08_COMPANY AND mf14.MF14_FACTORY = cm08.CM08_FACTORY AND mf14.MF14_CODE = cm08.CM08_CODE WHERE MF13_COMPANY = #{company} AND MF13_FACTORY = #{factory} AND MF13_NO = #{mf13No}
